Omega: Number of microstates of a macrostate: here the number of paths that end in a bin
P: Probability that a ball lands in bin k
k: Bin number: how many of its bounces went right
mu: Mean of the bin number, np
p: Chance of bouncing right at each peg
s: Sample standard deviation of the bin numbers of the balls dropped
sigma: Standard deviation of the bin number, √(np(1 − p))
